headline: Dead Lands Roar Anew as Stonecradle Flares
war_summary: The Dead Lands lead this edition: a front reported cooling at our last press has rekindled, hourly losses now running some three hundred sixty Colonial and five hundred Warden and still climbing, with Callahan's Boot again the busiest point. Stonecradle, until now a quiet Warden province, has flared within the past two hours, losses leaping from a trickle past four hundred an hour, though not one work has changed hands there. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest field of the day — twenty-six base actions in twenty-four hours, Necropolis the most contested of them — though its own toll eases. Fishermans Row grinds on with thirty-six actions in the day, Peripti Landing and Arcadia the busiest works; Godcrofts and Stlican Shelf stay restless; Kings Cage yielded a Colonial capture at the Den of Knaves. Linn Mercy, near eight hundred the hour in our last, has cooled by more than half. Oarbreaker has gone still inside two hours, and Lykos Isle and Tempest Island have gone quiet. The ledger reads two hundred fifty-eight Colonial works to one hundred seventy-five Warden, with three in ruin about Godcrofts and Tempest Island. It is the war's one-hundred-thirty-first day; thirty-four victory towns remain the prize.
